justification: Insufficient modularization is present. In [MemberSubstitution.java](/data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/raphw/byte-buddy/byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/asm/MemberSubstitution.java), the `Step` subtree spans roughly lines 1903-7252 inside a 9320-line file and contains many distinct responsibilities: `Resolution`, `Factory`, `OfOriginalExpression`, `Simple`, `ForAssignment`, `ForArgumentSubstitution`, `ForArgumentLoading`, `ForField` with `Read`/`Write`, `ForInvocation`, and `ForDelegation` with its own `Factory` and `OffsetMapping` hierarchy. I also counted 86 nested type declarations and 222 public declarations inside that subtree, which is strong evidence of a large, low-cohesion abstraction that could be split into smaller units.
